tools.name: nmap_scan
tools.description: Port scanning and network discovery. TCP SYN scan (-sS) for stealth, service version detection (-sV), OS fingerprinting (-O). Root required for SYN scan.

target.description: Target IP, hostname, or CIDR range (e.g. 192.168.1.0/24).

tools.name: ss_sockets
tools.description: Socket statistics — show listening and established TCP/UDP connections with process info. Linux socket telemetry tool replacing netstat.

flags.description: ss flags. Default: -tulnp (TCP+UDP listening, numeric, processes). Use -tunap for all connections.

tools.name: tcpdump_capture
tools.description: Network packet capture and analysis. Shows raw packet headers, traffic patterns. Root required.

interface.description: Network interface to capture on (e.g. eth0, wlan0, any).

count.description: Number of packets to capture before stopping. Default: 50.

tools.name: strace_trace
tools.description: System call tracer. Trace syscalls made by a process — see file operations, network calls, memory allocation. Use -c for summary counts, -p for attaching to PID.

flags.description: strace flags. Default: -c (summary). Use '-f -e trace=network' for network syscalls, '-p PID' to attach.

pid.description: Attach to running process by PID instead of running command.

tools.name: lsof_list
tools.description: List open files — file descriptors, network connections, unix sockets, pipes. Shows which process has what open.

flags.description: lsof flags. Default: -i (network connections). Use '-p PID' for specific process, '-u user' for user files.

pid.description: Show open files for specific process ID.

path.description: Show processes using this file/directory path.
